constraints.text: WM-ORG-004 remains the sole master of durable Position identity, definition, placement, authorized capacity, funding frame, requirements and seat-level authority.
Position survives vacancy, occupant replacement and deletion or erasure of an occupant record; no cascade from person or occupancy may delete or rewrite the seat.
Occupancy or assignment remains the external owner of who occupies a Position, the occupied interval and consumed capacity; this profile does not copy those facts onto Position.
Job or class, Position, Occupancy or assignment, and BusinessRole concept remain distinct semantic layers.
Occupation, job family, grade, skill and role vocabularies remain external versioned schemes; Position and PartyRole store only pinned references and evidence.
BusinessRole remains an identifier-unassigned versioned concept-scheme candidate and fills the external role-reference slots in both bases by reference only.
WM-XCT-023 remains the master of addressable, time-bounded PartyRole assertions linking a player or Position, host, role concept, validity, scope and authority basis.
Accountability, held DecisionRight and RaciAssignment are profile labels over WM-XCT-023 and do not become sibling entity roots.
Role assertions may use a Position as player; the current bearer is resolved only through the external occupancy plane.
One party or agent may hold multiple concurrent PartyRole assertions when their host, scope, concept or validity differs and no applicable conflict rule forbids it.
All standards statements remain alignment-only; no conformance claim is permitted.
Legacy O2 organizational-unit and O3 fused employment/membership meanings MUST NOT be imported into WM-ORG-004 Position; legacy scope remains unresolved until migration adjudication.
Canonical reuse MUST be refused while registry/spec entry-kind divergence or registry currency drift remains unresolved.

Vacancy is derived at an as-of instant from active status, abolition date, hiring status, authorized FTE/headcount and effective occupancy; the closed states are vacant, partly-filled, fully-filled, over-established, frozen and abolished.
An abolished seat is never vacant or fillable; a frozen seat is not fillable; comparison of FTE uses a declared unit and precision.
Vacancy may be stored only as a stamped recomputable projection carrying asOf, inputsDigest and derivedAt; stale or conflicting projections MUST be rejected and recomputed.
Derived seat vacancy remains distinct from any recruitment vacancy or position-opening artifact.
Position type absent permits at most one holder; authorized headcount greater than one requires pooled type; FTE and headcount ceilings are enforced independently.
Capacity override requires named authority, reason, bounded validity and recorded outcome; a warning alone never satisfies a refusal rule.
Job-share semantics are declared-local-no-primary-source and MUST NOT support a canonical capability claim.
RACI assertions MUST carry profileRef and only effective, active, direct, standing assertions with that marker participate in cardinality.

RACI classification axis is functional or statutory; host kind is decision, deliverable, process or control; host revision is pinned; exactly one mapped role-type code at the strictest binding strength is required.

For one pinned host revision and evaluated interval, exactly one active direct Accountable and at least one active direct Responsible are required; duplicate-key validation is not cardinality enforcement.
Derived, cascaded, suspended, revoked and activity-participation assertions do not satisfy RACI counts.

Accountable player is a party or a single-capacity Position, except where an explicit designation rule authorizes another shape; collectives, proportional shares, quorum sets and pooled Positions are refused by default.
Seat-level DecisionRight belongs to WM-ORG-004; held DecisionRight belongs to a WM-XCT-023 profile; assignment-time conveyance remains external; IAM enforcement is a fourth plane.
Occupancy MUST NOT imply held authority; vacancy escalation requires a separately identified, bounded PartyRole assertion.
Each incompatible-role pair declares static or dynamic separation; dynamic separation requires an enforcement-point reference.
SoD evaluation traverses delegation and on-behalf-of chains and resolves Position players to effective occupants; unresolved occupancy fails closed.
SoD exceptions carry approver, scope, start, expiry, review cadence and a profile-local compensating-control reference; expiry auto-suspends or refuses the conflicting assertion.
Delegation revocation does not retroactively invalidate prior acts unless a separate adjudication record says so.
SoD evidence status is dimension-local-no-primary-source and no incompatibility matrix may be represented as a published standard.
Authorization flow is one-way: a profile assertion may be policy input; an IAM grant, entitlement, group or session does not create, evidence or renew the profile assertion.
constraint-expression expresses real-world representation and decision limits only and does not encode permissions, resources or system actions.
Position and PartyRole histories are bitemporal: valid/effective time and knowledge/record time are preserved; a third event-time axis is not claimed as base-supported.
Abolition is terminal for a Position identifier; reinstatement mints a new Position identity with a supersession link, and the abolition business instant remains distinct from record closure.
Corrections append superseding versions; substantive Position changes append a new effective version; host revisions are never retroactively re-pointed.
Player erasure tombstones or anonymizes the player reference while retaining the assertion and closed-interval counts where retention requires it.
Non-human agents may hold PartyRole assertions when the profile permits; they do not occupy a human Position by default.
Canonical publication is refused while any base hold, candidate relation, missing dependency pin, registry divergence, unallocated vocabulary or unexecuted fixture remains open.

inheritedHolds.text: Source verification is incomplete: every base URL and version pin must be re-resolved at publication time. In particular the base cites 5 CFR and 29 CFR from the Cornell LII reproduction because eCFR and opm.gov were unreachable in its run, while grok reached eCFR current as of 2026-08-20 and the OPM classification standards PDF; re-verify and dual-cite or swap to the official host before publishing.

Source identifiers collide across providers with different underlying documents (SRC-002 is HR Open in the base and Popolo in grok, among others). All sources must be re-keyed during merge and every accepted addition re-pointed, and the merged source list re-verified as live, before any draft is published.

ISO 30400:2022 must not be cited as defining position, job, role or FTE: grok's own note concedes the term text was not inspectable behind the paywall, so only the standard's existence, date and scope are supportable. The ISCO-08 citation must likewise resolve to an authoritative ILO or UNSD host rather than the third-party netlify mirror used by grok.

Retention and disposition periods remain a declared gap. No fetched primary source in either pack states a retention period for position records, descriptions or classification decisions; the structure may be published only as a required local determination, never as canonical guidance.

Multi-profile domain validation is outstanding. Evidence concentrates on US federal General Schedule classification, UK FCA prescribed responsibilities, EU pay transparency and a single HCM vendor API. Before publication the model must be exercised against at least a civic or legislative profile (Popolo post with constituency), a healthcare profile (FHIR PractitionerRole unnamed slot) and a non-US private-sector profile, and every regional assumption must be labelled a jurisdiction profile rather than a universal requirement.

Published boundary notes must carry grok's disambiguations verbatim in substance: HL7 FHIR PractitionerRole is aligned, not equated, to a classified position, and the financial, geospatial and sports senses of the word position are excluded, including schema.org's Quarterback example of a named position.

Source verification: re-fetch and version-pin every base source plus the grok sources underwriting adopted findings (UN/CEFACT PartyRoleCodeList and partyRoleCode, HL7 RoleClass, FHIR PractitionerRole and Provenance), and reconcile the R5-pinned versus unpinned FHIR URLs the two providers used for the same resources.

Multi-profile validation: the mixin must be exercised against at least healthcare (PractitionerRole), geospatial metadata (CI_Responsibility), trade/customs (UN/CEFACT), telecom (TMF669), LEI relationship records and research credit (CRediT/DataCite) before any claim that it is domain-neutral; only healthcare and geospatial are jointly evidenced today.

HL7 v3 RoleClass player/scoper definitions are the weakest verified retrieval in the base (page rendered navigation only; definitions confirmed via search index). Grok fetched the same code system successfully, so re-verify directly before publishing any scoper-dependent structure.

ISO 19115-1 normative wording is unverified: both providers relied on ICSM's public documentation of a paywalled standard. Mark CI_Responsibility and CI_RoleCode claims as secondary-sourced or obtain the standard.

Audit the base's ODRL 2.2 citations on player-kind-and-vacancy, role-extent-and-characteristics, statutory-role-obligations, representation-and-limits and disclosure-tiers-and-minimization; ODRL is a rights-expression vocabulary and may be over-cited relative to what it actually states.

Record registry-level precedence decisions before publication for the two fuzzy sibling boundaries: ownership-as-property-right against the existing Ownership and Stewardship entry, and GLEIF parent/subsidiary represented as a relationship record versus a role assertion.
